verdict.rationale: Ledgy is a cap-table platform, so this axis applies. The evidence shows in-platform signing of share-award contracts, alone or in bulk (docs-12, docs-10), and documents attached to cap table transactions (docs-7), which comes close to signed equity documents linked to ledger entries. However, nothing mentions electronic share certificates specifically. Missing for 10: explicit electronic share certificate issuance, evidence that signatures are legally binding, a documented permanent certificate-to-cap-table-entry link, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
